summary: Phase D Customer Portal — verified public /track/{token} + write endpoints and owner-side portal wiring end-to-end. 17/18 backend tests pass (1 real bug), all frontend flows work in the browser. Found ONE backend bug: `owner_alert_phone` is accepted+persisted by PUT /api/settings/integrations but is missing from `INTEGRATION_PLAIN` in `_integration_settings_out()`, so both GET and PUT responses omit it → the new Integrations input reads back empty after every reload, breaking the SMS-target UX (and hiding whether SMS is armed).

critical.issue: `owner_alert_phone` never appears in the response body. PUT accepts it and $set's it into Mongo (payload.model_dump includes it), but `_integration_settings_out` iterates INTEGRATION_PLAIN = ('square_location_id','square_notification_url','openphone_number','default_truck_pickup') which does NOT include 'owner_alert_phone'. Fix: add 'owner_alert_phone' to INTEGRATION_PLAIN at /app/backend/server.py L1096 (or add a dedicated line in the output dict). Verified via pytest test_integrations_owner_alert_phone_roundtrip and by saving in the UI (Settings → Integrations) then reloading — the input is empty again despite Save success toast.

ui_bugs.issue: Value does not persist visibly after save+reload because backend GET omits owner_alert_phone (backend bug above). Input itself renders and accepts input.

action_items: Add 'owner_alert_phone' to INTEGRATION_PLAIN in /app/backend/server.py (~L1096) so GET/PUT /api/settings/integrations echoes it. This will fix both the API round-trip and the UI persistence for the new 'Your cell for portal alerts' input.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1096: INTEGRATION_PLAIN tuple was not updated when owner_alert_phone was added to IntegrationsPayload (L1107). Because _integration_settings_out only echoes fields listed in INTEGRATION_PLAIN, the new field is silently dropped from every read. The value IS persisted (PUT $set includes it), so the user's stored SMS phone can still fire real SMS on portal events even though the UI shows an empty field — a foot-gun that could leak the owner's number into notifications without them realizing it is armed. High-priority fix.

server.py L1428-1436 upload-throttle logic reads `job.get('portal_upload_notice_at')` from the pre-upload snapshot, so two rapid uploads inside a single request-batch (before the $set persists) can both bypass the 15-min throttle. Not observed in tests (sequential calls with awaits properly re-read the doc via _job_by_token), but worth pinning down if you ever batch-upload.

rca_of_the_issue: owner_alert_phone bug: In /app/backend/server.py, IntegrationsPayload (L1099-1107) was extended with `owner_alert_phone`, and the PUT handler (L1128) does `payload.model_dump()` and $set's the whole dict, so it is stored in Mongo correctly. However `_integration_settings_out()` (L1110-1118) hardcodes plain-text fields via the `INTEGRATION_PLAIN` tuple (L1096), which was NOT updated with 'owner_alert_phone'. Result: every GET/PUT response omits the field → the IntegrationsCard input reads empty even after a successful save. Reproduction: PUT /api/settings/integrations {"owner_alert_phone":"+15550001234"} → 200 but response body has no owner_alert_phone key; GET returns the same shape without it. Fix: change L1096 to INTEGRATION_PLAIN = ('square_location_id','square_notification_url','openphone_number','default_truck_pickup','owner_alert_phone'). Optional hardening: also strip/normalize the phone in the payload before saving.
